rationale.org-governance: Enterprise-wide guardrail enforces outbound source-code protection across organizational workflows.
rationale.framework: Reusable classifier architecture integrates with SIEM, API proxies, and DLP.
rationale.built-system: Authors trained and evaluated a working UniXcoder-based sensitivity classifier.
rationale.steering: Filters code entering public LLMs, controlling generation inputs rather than outputs.
rationale.risk-security: Mitigates leakage of credentials, personal data, business logic, and infrastructure details.
rationale.risk-ip: Substantively detects and blocks proprietary source-code exposure to public LLMs.
rationale.method-field-study: Evaluated the classifier on ten days of real organizational traffic.
rationale.demote:context: Steering-only contribution filters LLM inputs without inspecting generated artifacts.
